en: Colorized historic postcard showing a busy central square with a large stone monument in the middle, horse‑drawn carriages, people walking and trading, and a tram. Surrounding the square are multi‑story buildings, including a grand neo‑renaissance style building with a sign on the façade. The printed caption at the top reads "PÉCS. Széchényi-tér". The reverse side contains handwritten text, address lines, the printed Hungarian phrase "Levelező-Lap", printer's mark "N. E. Bpest VIII", and a red Hungarian postage stamp inscribed "MAGYAR KIR. POSTA" and "10 FILLÉR".
